_comment: What the P/D arms EXECUTE differently on the Vast 4x A100-SXM4-80GB node with every instance at TP1 (owner 2026-10-26: 1P1D = prefill GPU 0 + decode GPU 1; 2P2D = prefill GPUs 0 and 1 + decode GPUs 2 and 3), declared BEFORE any cell (incident-graph-ladder-confound-20260916, rule 1). Each instance runs the paper's single-A100-80GB integrated setting (execution_differences.json: fp16, mem 0.8, Triton, decode ladder 1024 for both arms); only SGLang's P/D settings are added, identical in both arms. TP1 -> TP1 KV transfers use mooncake's plain path (no staging buffer).

tolerances._note: rel 0.015 as the paper's A100-80GB declaration (~3,840 displaced tokens = 0.98 % of a ~393k pool); abs 3856 = 3,840 + 16 for SGLang's boot-to-boot pool jitter (measured on the 40 GB node 2026-10-25). A smaller treatment pool only ever costs the treatment.

upstream_pd_g1024.reason: P/D decode instance (TP1): same-ladder control, upstream + --cuda-graph-max-bs 1024 = the fork's 4x max_bs ladder on this card (the paper's upstream_g1024)

vskipper_pd.reason: P/D decode instance = the paper's served design at TP1 (vskipper): ladder 1024 (4x max_bs); band by the rule for the A100-80GB (160k/200k); router/projector weights shrink the pool by <1.5 %; each request's body is pinned when it arrives at the decode instance (decode_pin_disaggregated)

upstream_pd_g1024__decode_b.reason: 2P2D second decode instance (TP1 on GPU 3): P/D decode instance (TP1): same-ladder control, upstream + --cuda-graph-max-bs 1024 = the fork's 4x max_bs ladder on this card (the paper's upstream_g1024)
